{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Compute change in biomarker
trial_df['biomarker_change'] = trial_df['biomarker_final'] - trial_df['biomarker_baseline']

# Identify rows where baseline or final is sentinel (-999.0)
has_sentinel = (trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0) | (trial_df['biomarker_final'] == -999.0)

# Now compute mean change by arm, excluding sentinel cases
trial_df_clean = trial_df[~has_sentinel]
mean_change_by_arm = trial_df_clean.groupby('arm')['biomarker_change'].mean()

# Verify the difference between arms
mean_control = mean_change_by_arm['control']
mean_treatment = mean_change_by_arm['treatment']
mean_diff = mean_treatment - mean_control

# Check if the difference is statistically significant with a t-test
from scipy.stats import ttest_ind
control_change = trial_df_clean[trial_df_clean['arm'] == 'control']['biomarker_change']
treatment_change = trial_df_clean[trial_df_clean['arm'] == 'treatment']['biomarker_change']
t_stat, p_value = ttest_ind(treatment_change, control_change, equal_var=False)

print('Mean change - control:', mean_control)
print('Mean change - treatment:', mean_treatment)
print('Difference (treatment - control):', mean_diff)
print('t-statistic:', t_stat)
print('p-value:', p_value)"}
